auditor_lee: Hi team — SOC2 evidence request. We flagged an RBAC change (rb-214) during CVE-2026-0305 triage on 2026-04-02. Need: raw KMS/CloudTrail events showing no external key export, a short rollback note, and remediation artifacts (PR + deploy IDs).

nina-sec: Copy. We'll assemble raw CloudTrail + SIEM correlation. Preference is raw events.

chris-sre: Uploaded bundle to presigned S3: s3://redwood-evidence/1810000001/ (cloudtrail_kms.json.gz, siem_rbac_alerts.log, rb-214-rollback.txt, cve-0305-fix.md, manifest.sig)

dan-eng: rb-214 rollback excerpt: "Reverted rolebinding rb-214 at 2026-04-02T11:02:10Z after canary detected widened scope. Revert executed by dan-eng via ops-runbook v3.0. Canary stable at 11:08Z. Ticket: INF-4529."

nina-sec: CloudTrail snippet (excerpt): { "eventTime": "2026-04-02T10:58:03Z", "eventName": "GenerateDataKey", "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-x" }, "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/aa11-bb22" } }

nina-sec: Importantly, no Decrypt events with externalRecipient metadata in the 10:30-11:30Z window. We also produced an envelope-proof HMAC: s3://redwood-evidence/1810000001/kms-envelope-hmac.txt (HMAC verified).

evidence-bot: Automated check: manifest.sig verified with compliance key ck-17; hashes match uploaded files.

auditor_lee: Thanks. Small follow-ups: paste first line of rb-214 rollback inline and PR link + deploy tags for the CVE fix.

dan-eng: First line: "Revert rb-214 applied 2026-04-02T11:02:10Z by dan-eng. Cause: canary permission expansion."

chris-sre: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1422
Deploy tags: deploy-usw2-20260402-12, canary-20260402-5

auditor_lee: Last check — any CMK policy edits in that hour?

nina-sec: Confirmed no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, or ScheduleKeyDeletion events for key aa11-bb22 between 2026-04-02T10:00Z and 2026-04-02T12:00Z. Only a maintenance policy change on 2026-03-01 unrelated.

auditor_lee: Perfect, I'll include these in the SOC2 packet and map to CC6.2. If we need signed attestations, I'll ask. :thumbsup:
